opportunities.title: No cloud text-to-speech voice found, though open resources exist
opportunities.detail: None of the cloud services checked has a voice for this language. Open datasets hold 642 hours of transcribed speech.
opportunities.why: About 12 million Igbo speakers are online today, and that should reach 16 million within five years. Ready to use: NaijaVoices (626 hours of transcribed speech); FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: No published LLM benchmark results
opportunities.detail: Neither of the two multilingual benchmarks we track reports this language. Adding it would give builders and buyers a baseline.
opportunities.why: About 7.9 million Igbo speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 11 million within five years. Ready to use: FLORES-200 (covers this language); Belebele (covers this language).

opportunities.title: No published speech recognition error rate
opportunities.detail: The language isn't in the published FLEURS error-rate breakdowns we track, so builders can't tell how usable open speech recognition is.

opportunities.detail: The iOS keyboard has 0 of 4 typing features. FineWeb-2 holds about 76 million words of openly licensed web text, enough to train word prediction.
